notes.title: v0.16.0
notes.content: New play mode: SPEED CHALLENGE! Compete with others to see how many flowers you can find. Pick from one of six islands and try to get a high score before the time runs out!

notes.title: Wild Isles v0.15.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Island generation time is 3x faster! In testing, load time went from ~30 seconds to ~10 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.14.0 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Grass is now interactable and bends as you walk over it. 
[*] Improved logging.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.13.0 now LIVE!
notes.content: Bug fixes and integration of back-end service for future account management, leaderboards, etc.

notes.title: Wild Isles v0.12.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now move while holding the map, but at 40% reduced speed.
[*] Compass and spyglass also reduce speed by 20%.
[/list]

[/list]
